analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited recorded a revenue from continuing operations of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 809.85 lakhs for FY 2024-25. The company completed the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited, with trading in the resulting entity commencing in March 2025. The Board recommended a dividend of 10% (Rs.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through commercialization of high-margin products.
guidance.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: The company focuses on building a sustainable business model centered on profitable revenue growth and launching high-margin research-based products for domestic and overseas markets.
guidance.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

guidance.claim: The company plans to venture into new markets with favorable competition and focus on complex new products as it enters fiscal 2024.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

demand_outlook.claim: The company aims to continuously enhance its product portfolio to fulfill dynamic market demands.
demand_outlook.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprint in new territories have yielded positive results.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced all-round growth during the financial year 2022-23.
demand_outlook.quote: The financial year 2022-23 was marked by continuing all-round growth for your company and our team continued to push forward with passion.

capex_expansion.claim: Equity shares of the resulting entity Vikram Aroma Limited have been allotted to shareholders and are awaiting final BSE/SEBI listing approval.
capex_expansion.quote: The equity shares of resulting company M/s Vikram Aroma Limited have already been allotted to the shareholders of your company and we are awaiting the final approval of BSE/SEBI for the listing/trading of the shares of Vikram Aroma Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge the company's Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Foreign exchange outgo for raw material imports stood at Rs 86.23 lakhs during FY 2024-25.
Vikram Thermo achieved its highest ever revenue of Rs. 12,639.54 lacs and profit after tax of Rs. 2,537.87 lacs in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: The revenue of Rs. 12639.54 lacs and profit after tax of Rs. 2537.87 lacs is best ever in the history of the company.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for FY 2023-24 increased to Rs. 12,754.76 Lakhs compared to Rs. 11,289.13 Lakhs in FY 2022-23.
margins_costs.quote: Total Income increased to Rs. 12754.76 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 11289.13 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2022-23.

margins_costs.claim: Profit before tax rose to Rs. 3,406.14 Lakhs in FY 2023-24 from Rs. 2,303.51 Lakhs in FY 2022-23.
margins_costs.quote: PBT increased to Rs. 3406.14 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 2303.51 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2022-23.

margins_costs.claim: Operating income grew by 20.95% to Rs. 112.89 crores and profit after tax rose by 94.59% to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating income grew to Rs. 112.89 crores, a growth of 20.95% as compared to the previous FY 2022, Our profits after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores, in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.

margins_costs.claim: Profit before tax reached Rs. 2,303.50 Lakhs in FY 2022-23 compared to Rs. 1,176.54 Lakhs in FY 2021-22.
margins_costs.quote: PBT increased to Rs. 2303.50 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 1176.54 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2021-22.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 10% dividend amounting to Rs. 1 per equity share of Rs. 10 each for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed dividend payment will lead to a total cash outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any profit to reserves for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent Rs. 52,00,000 towards its CSR obligation in FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is pleased to inform the members that an amount of Rs. 52,00,000 towards its CSR obligation for 2024-25 has been spent which is over and above the requirement as specified by the Government and it is committed to further spend appropriate amount towards its obligation of the current financial year during 2024-25 as well.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10 each, representing Rs. 0.75 per share for FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payment will result in a total cash outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/- (Previous Year Rs. 1,56,78,925/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves in FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 5% (Rs. 0.50 per share) on the post-bonus enhanced equity capital.
capital_allocation.quote: your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.50 per share on post bonus enhanced paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued bonus shares in the ratio of 4 equity shares for every 1 equity share held during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the company has declared issue of bonus shares to the shareholders in the ratio of 4 Equity shares for every 1 equity shares held.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business demerger allows the company to isolate risks between separate entities.
risks_headwinds.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company implemented a Risk Management Policy to manage risks that could impact business operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company continuously assesses internal and external risks related to strategy, operations, legal compliance, financial reporting, IT systems, and cyber security.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company navigated global uncertainties and aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic during FY 2022-23.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to driving profitable revenue growth by commercializing tailored, high-margin research products.
management_commitments.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to consistent investments in R&D and the adoption of emerging technologies.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to investing continuously in R&D, exploring emerging technologies, and enhancing its product range.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company will enter new markets with favorable competitive dynamics and work on new, complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
